fields.title: 6. Three data points to check directly before the next issue (T5 checkpoint 10/31 or monthly 2026-11)
fields.md:
1. **EDGAR 8-K** (due 10/29–30) — Tranche-by-tranche size, interest rate, collateral (chip range), maturity, call terms, and convertible/equity-raise elements in Item 2.03/1.01 and Ex.10/99. If present, deliberate proposed new rule ② and tally D-2027-1 using `definitions.additional_financing` ([EDGAR 8-K list](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001181412&type=8-K&dateb=&owner=include&count=10)).
2. **Alternative primary sources if there is no 8-K** — SpaceX IR press releases, Apollo and Atlas SP announcements, and the off-balance-sheet commitments and lease notes in the 4Q26 10-K (estimated 2027-02). Whether the SPV is consolidated (proposed new rule ③) is determined here ([ir.spacex.com](https://ir.spacex.com/updates/default.aspx)).
3. **Official Starlink US residential pricing + the Amazon Leo Vulcan LV-01 (10/29) result** — preparation for the T4 checkpoint 12/01. This is outside the scope of this issue, so it was not touched (source: section 5 of the previous issue).
